record.title: Review Linux bench readiness and define the cable migration checkpoint
record.intent: Admit physical link introduction only after a small independently verified host setup.
requirements: Independently inspect preserved baseline, actual namespace routes and interfaces, forwarding, DHCP configuration, recorder statistics and standard-tool provenance. Verify management connectivity is retained and no specimen contact occurred. Do not require unrelated global firewall state to be empty or disabled.

Keep conclusions about host-local controls distinct from scope reachability and RF qualification. Record the exact next physical cable transition and the minimum capture-first lease, identity and transport checks. Retain the current RF coax path and all stock, option and calibration invariants.

Decide whether to admit the bounded physical migration. Tasking must be planned, inspected, admitted against the expected revision and committed/pushed before execution. No new scope reboot, firmware, entitlement, calibration or RF measurement is included in host readiness.
acceptance: A reviewed host readiness result and concrete physical migration proposal are preserved.
